title: Earnings Integrity Standard — Standing Allowance on Duplicate Mileage Recoveries, Cartwise Shopper Batches
content:
The duplicate standing allowance is subtracted from the full amount of the later mileage posting of a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch before a duplicate is taken back, and the amount remaining is never below zero. It is:

- **0.50** when the shopper account carries **no active violation points** and **no late-delivery violation** is recorded against the batch;
- **0.25** when the account carries **one or two active violation points** and **at most one** late-delivery violation is recorded against the batch, **or** when it carries **no active points** and **exactly one** such violation is recorded;
- **nothing** otherwise.

Both inputs come from the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record: the active violation points balance, and the late-delivery violations recorded against this particular batch.

## Full combination table

| Active violation points | Late-delivery violations against the batch | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0.50 |
| 0 | 1 | 0.25 |
| 0 | 2 or more | Nothing |
| 1 or 2 | 0 | 0.25 |
| 1 or 2 | 1 | 0.25 |
| 1 or 2 | 2 or more | Nothing |
| 3 or more | Any | Nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- No points and no late-delivery violation, later posting 4.35: 4.35 less 0.50 leaves 3.85.
- Two points and one late-delivery violation against the batch: 0.25.
- No points, but two late-delivery violations against the batch: nothing.
- A late-delivery violation recorded against a different batch does not count for this batch.
